_descriptor_type: A type of descriptor. One of 'simulation', 'trace', and 'perf'.
_architecture: A name of the available architectures (PARAMS.<architecture>) found in scarab repository, which defines the machine parameters of the default configuration.
_experiment: The name of the experiment. scarab-infra will create a new folder named containing all files needed to execute the simulation in the <ROOT_DIR>/simulations/<experiment> directory. The folder will also contain all generated simulation statistics/outputs.
_workload_manager: manual: run each exp scenario with all the simpoints at a time, slurm: Slurm schedules simulations based on its policy
_root_dir: Root directory mounted into the docker container home, for instance, the user's home directory
_application_dir: The path to the benchmark application directory used for tracing or simulation.
_scarab_path: The path to the scarab repository that contains the scarab binary used to run the experiment. Must be built from the td-load-rrip-min-extrapolate branch (adds the L1I front-end-bound marked-RRIP policy: td_fe_rrip_mark / td_fe_rrip_min_rrpv / td_fe_rrip_extrapolate / td_fe_rrip_extrap_anchor / td_fe_rrip_thresh).
_traces_dir: The local directory containing all simpointed traces
_top_simpoint: Run only top 3 simpoints stored in 'workloads_top_simp.json'.
_simulations: Front-end (L1 instruction cache) version of the marked-RRIP sweep -- the L1I analog of td_complete_sweep_datacenter_l2, NOT the L2. With --td_fe_rrip_mark the L1I uses REPL_MARKED_RRIP: each on-path demand icache miss's fill derives an initial RRPV from its front-end-bound fraction (of the cycles the fetch miss was outstanding, how many the front end was actually starving the machine = fe_bound_cycles / fe_window_cycles), computed on demand -- no CSV. The td_fe_rrip_* knob set is independent of the L1D/L2 td_load_rrip_* knobs; no --td_load_rrip_* / --td_load_rrip_on_mlc here. Insert-only for now (hits keep min(0,target)); note that under FDIP timely-prefetched lines insert at basic, so this bites mainly on fetch-stalling misses. Compare IPC / ICACHE_MISS vs. baseline with plot_stat_change.py.
_configurations: baseline = untouched L1I (REPL_TRUE_LRU). Every rrip_* config enables the L1I front-end-bound marked-RRIP policy and mirrors the L2 sweep, translated to the td_fe_rrip_* knobs: *_noextrap = fixed minimum RRPV, gated by td_fe_rrip_thresh (0.5); *_extrap_anchor / *_extrap_dN = extrapolate the FE-bound fraction to an RRPV in [min, RRIP_DISTANT_VAL-1] with the ramp lower-anchored at td_fe_rrip_extrap_anchor (dN denotes min=-N).

baseline._params: Untouched machine (default L1I replacement policy, REPL_TRUE_LRU).

rrip_min_neg8_noextrap._params: Fixed min RRPV -8, no extrapolation (FE-bound fraction > thresh -> -8, else basic).

rrip_min_neg2_extrap_anchor01._params: Extrapolate to min -2, ramp anchored at fraction 0.01.

rrip_min_neg4_extrap_anchor01._params: Extrapolate to min -4, ramp anchored at fraction 0.01.

rrip_min_neg8_extrap_anchor01._params: Extrapolate to min -8, ramp anchored at fraction 0.01.

rrip_min_neg16_extrap_anchor01._params: Extrapolate to min -16, ramp anchored at fraction 0.01.

rrip_min_neg64_extrap_anchor01._params: Extrapolate to min -64, ramp anchored at fraction 0.01.

rrip_anchor50_extrap_d8._params: Extrapolate to min -8, ramp anchored at fraction 0.50 (only misses >= 0.5 FE-bound protected).

rrip_anchor30_extrap_d8._params: Extrapolate to min -8, ramp anchored at fraction 0.30.

rrip_anchor10_extrap_d8._params: Extrapolate to min -8, ramp anchored at fraction 0.10.

rrip_anchor01_extrap_d8._params: Extrapolate to min -8, ramp anchored at fraction 0.01 (protect nearly any miss with FE-bound cycles).

_collect_stats: Stats collection settings for ./sci --collect-stats. configs: optional list of configuration names to collect (null or omitted = all configurations).
_visualize: Visualization settings for ./sci --visualize. Configure baseline and counters.
_mem: Memory scheduling and collection settings for Slurm jobs.
